material used to make the forehead-mark
absolutive expressing prior action before vinyaset
object of vinyaset; item to be placed
location where the flower is to be placed

items.question: What bodily applications of sandal and flower are required following the preceding consecration?
premises: A forehead-mark is to be made using sandal-paste.
A flower is to be placed on the head.
These actions are prescribed as ritual steps to be performed.
items.inference: After the prior consecration, the practitioner must apply a sandal forehead-mark and place a flower on the head.
uncertainties: The implicit subject performing vinyaset is not explicitly stated in this verse.
items.plain_english: Having made a forehead-mark with sandal-paste, one should place a flower on the head.
